name: Worldforged Eroded Sigil Stone is pickup-sized, not a tower (#9041)
contract: Pickup template 254162 (Eroded Sigil Stone, guid 6940444, map 0, Tirisfal Glades) uses display 1025463 (world/expansion01/doodads/generic/bloodelf/runestone/be_runestone01.m2, geo-box height 20.29 yd). At size 0.4 (set by #6146) it still stands 8.1 yd tall, about 6.6x the median apparent height (1.22 yd) of the 1,331 worldforged pickups whose display and size are fixed by the realm-map restoration. 0.06 brings it to about 1.22 yd, in line with every comparable pickup.
